prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: country learning postcard for Bulgaria
Primary request: The recognizable courtyard of Rila Monastery in its green Bulgarian mountain setting.
Subject: The central Church of the Nativity of the Theotokos, with distinctive alternating dark-and-white striped arcades, colourful exterior frescoes, rounded dark domes and a terracotta roof; the surrounding multi-storey white monastery galleries have arched colonnades, dark timber balconies and red tile roofs. Include the modest square medieval Hrelyo Tower nearby.
Scene/backdrop: A broad stone-paved monastery courtyard enclosed by galleries, with forested Rila mountain slopes visible behind, blue sky above.
Style/medium: Cheerful detailed children's-book travel illustration, painterly gouache and digital watercolour with visible brush texture, believable recognizable Bulgarian Orthodox architecture, gentle saturated teal, ochre, green and coral.
Composition/framing: One landscape 3:2 image, intended 1536x1024. Wide courtyard view, central church and tower comfortably inside central 75% width and height with generous breathing room. A few small visitors provide scale.
Lighting/mood: Warm natural daylight, peaceful and welcoming.
Constraints: Stylized educational illustration. No readable fresco inscriptions, text or letters, UI, flags, logos, watermark, postcard frame or stamp. No unrelated cathedral, fantasy castle, giant onion domes or invented landscape.
inspection: Inspected: recognizable striped church arcades, colourful frescoes, dark rounded domes, terracotta roofs, square Hrelyo Tower and multi-storey courtyard galleries with timber balconies. Green mountain slopes surround the scene. Tiny decorative pseudo-inscription marks appear on the upper curved gables; they are not readable words or UI text and root explicitly accepted them without correction. No flags or logos. Architecture and mountain view are illustrative rather than measured.
